name: Sakahashi Keisuke
source:
A middle school boy.
A boy who has strong sense of justice, boy who is unable to be bent.
He can't abadon people who are in trouble.
Always in quarel with his classmate Kasumi.
Prepared his life to protect other who neeeds.
